create_CLIPSegConfig: create a CLIPSegConfig with extract_layers, reduce_dim, and decoder_num_attention_heads settings
build_CLIPSegForImageSegmentation: build a CLIPSegForImageSegmentation model for zero-shot image segmentation from text prompts
run_CLIPSegSegmentation: run CLIPSegForImageSegmentation forward pass to produce pixel-level segmentation logits from text and images
get_conditional_embeddings: get conditional embeddings from text input_ids or conditional pixel values for segmentation conditioning
test_CLIPSegDecoder: test the CLIPSegDecoder that applies FiLM modulation and transposed convolution to predict segmentation masks
